title: ReportRecordedV2
description: Agent to gateway on agent-events.fifo: an investigation's final report, as in v1, plus the verdict of a live triage and every model asked for each part of the work. Sent once after the transaction that stored it; MessageGroupId is the investigation id and MessageDeduplicationId report-<investigation_id>, as in v1. Producers emit this version.

status.description: awaiting_approval when the report proposes actions, resolved otherwise.

verdict.description: A live triage's answer: real when the alert shows an incident a human must look at, not_real when it does not. Null for a simulated incident, and for a report the agent wrote itself after a stop. A not_real verdict never hides the alert.

models.description: Every model asked during the investigation, in the order first asked, once per part: triage for the investigation's turns, summary for log page summaries.

failed.description: Requests it did not answer, and requests the agent skipped before they reached it.

reason.description: Why the last of those failed or was skipped; null when it answered every request.

report.summary: freight-audit's api fails its readiness check: Postgres refuses connections since 09:52.

hypotheses.summary: The api's readiness check fails on postgres from 09:52, and the postgres container restarts.

models.reason: QuotaExhausted: claude-haiku-5-5 skipped: today's Claude spend plus this call's worst case passes the triage cap of $0.40 (UTC)
